cover.alt: Giske står høy og stolt i måneskinnet med svarte armer, svarte bein og en svart klatt på nesa. Bak de lange beina hennes kikker to tyver forsiktig fram.

Create the cover illustration for a children's picture book, in a square format. Do not write a title or any other text on it.

Picture: Sooty Giske stands tall in the moonlight at the edge of a dark spruce forest, hands on her hips and a big proud grin on her face, her black arms and legs and the black blob on her nose plain to see. The Skinny Thief and the Plump Thief peek out nervously from behind her long legs, one clutching his sack and the other his rope. A big round moon hangs in the starry autumn sky.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- Sooty Giske: Giske after the widower's trick: the same very tall, strong woman with the longest legs in the village, a long oval face, hazel eyes, a wide mouth and flaxen hair in a tall bun on top of her head. Her arms and long bare legs are smeared completely black with sticky soot, her cheeks are smudged, and a big round black blob sits on the tip of her nose. Her knee-length plum-purple dress and cream apron are streaked with black, and a ring of big iron keys hangs on her belt.
- the Skinny Thief: A skinny, jittery thief of about thirty, a head shorter than Giske, with a long pale face, a long pointy nose, big frightened eyes, a wispy ginger goatee and lank hair under a floppy black knitted hat. He wears a patched charcoal jacket that is too short in the arms, grey striped trousers and worn-out shoes, and carries an empty flour sack under his arm.
- the Plump Thief: A short, round, nervous thief of about forty, much shorter than Giske, with a round red face, puffy cheeks, a stubbly double chin, tiny eyes, a big bushy black moustache and a bald head under a brown flat cap. He wears a tight mustard-brown waistcoat with one button missing over a grey shirt, baggy trousers held up with rope and big boots, and carries a coil of rope over his shoulder.

Story world: Old rural Norway, long ago, in a small farming village of red and grey log farms with turf roofs, scattered among fields, woods and bogs. The widower's little red farmhouse has a low kitchen with a plank table, and next to it grows a field of tall, bushy green hemp. Beyond the village lies a big, dark spruce forest. The farms have sheep barns, goose houses and, at the rich farmer's, a stabbur: a dark timber storehouse on stilts, hung inside with sausages and hams and with shelves of round loaves. On Sunday morning everything happens at the Turnip Field above the bog. Giske's soot is black and sticky, made of tallow and chimney soot.

This story's season, light and colours: Early autumn at hemp-pulling time: tall green-gold hemp, pale stubble fields and birches just turning yellow under a hazy blue sky. The three raids happen on dark, starry nights lit only by a thin moon and one warm lantern, and Sunday morning is fresh and dewy, with pearl-grey mist over the brown bog. characters.name: Giske
characters.description: Sterk og flink hushjelp med lange bein som blir smurt svart med talg og sot mens hun sover, tror hun er et troll og hjelper to tyver altfor høylytt.
characters.look: A very tall, strong woman of about thirty with the longest legs in the village, a head taller than any man, long arms and big bare feet. She has a long oval face, rosy weathered cheeks, a wide eager smile, a small turned-up nose, bright hazel eyes and flaxen hair wound into a tall bun on top of her head. She wears a knee-length plum-purple wool dress with the sleeves rolled above the elbows, a cream apron and a ring of big iron keys on her belt.

characters.name: Giske som troll
characters.description: Giske smurt svart med talg og sot på armer, bein og nese, så hun tror hun er blitt et troll. Beina er like lange som før, og stemmen er høyere enn noensinne.
characters.look: Giske after the widower's trick: the same very tall, strong woman with the longest legs in the village, a long oval face, hazel eyes, a wide mouth and flaxen hair in a tall bun on top of her head. characters.name: Enkemannen
characters.description: Enkemannen Giske steller hus for, så lei av masingen hennes at han smører henne inn med sot mens hun sover.
characters.look: A skinny, stooped widower of about fifty with a long, narrow, tired face, heavy-lidded eyes, a long crooked nose, hollow cheeks, a scruffy salt-and-pepper chin beard and thin dark hair combed flat. He wears a collarless off-white shirt, dark-blue braces, baggy grey trousers, a darned heather-brown knitted cardigan and worn leather slippers, and he always looks as if he longs for some peace and quiet.

characters.name: Den tynne tyven
characters.description: Den ene av de to sultne tyvene som tar med seg Giske fordi hun vet hvor sauene bor. Han er tynn og skvetten og hysjer mest av alle.
characters.look: A skinny, jittery thief of about thirty, a head shorter than Giske, with a long pale face, a long pointy nose, big frightened eyes, a wispy ginger goatee and lank hair under a floppy black knitted hat. characters.name: Den tykke tyven
characters.description: Den andre av de to sultne tyvene. Han er liten og rund, og magen hans rumler så fælt at han gjerne vil ha med seg et troll når de skal ut og stjele.
characters.look: A short, round, nervous thief of about forty, much shorter than Giske, with a round red face, puffy cheeks, a stubbly double chin, tiny eyes, a big bushy black moustache and a bald head under a brown flat cap. He wears a tight mustard-brown waistcoat with one button missing over a grey shirt, baggy trousers held up with rope and big boots, and carries a coil of rope over his shoulder.

characters.name: Bonden
characters.description: Bonden som våkner av bråket, kommer ut med lykta og blir livredd for trollet som herjer på gårdene.
characters.look: A lean, wiry farmer of about forty-five with a bony, hollow-cheeked face, a hooked nose, bristly grey stubble, startled round eyes and wild, tousled grey hair, just woken up. He wears only a long, loose, undyed linen nightshirt that reaches his knees, with bare skinny legs and bare feet, and holds up a small tin lantern with a warm, flickering candle inside.

characters.name: Bonden med nepeåkeren
characters.description: Bonden som eier nepeåkeren. Han ser trollet midt i nepene sine, lokker presten ut av senga med en kalvestek og bærer ham over myra på ryggen.
characters.look: A short, sturdy, bow-legged farmer of about fifty with a square, weather-beaten face, a big bristly chestnut moustache, round startled eyes, bushy eyebrows and wiry grey hair that sticks up under a wide, frayed straw hat. He wears a faded rust-orange wool vest over a white shirt with rolled sleeves, green knee breeches, long grey socks and wooden clogs.

characters.name: Presten
characters.description: Søvnig prest i nattlue og tøfler som blir lokket ut av senga med en kalvestek og havner midt i myra.
characters.look: A very round, heavy priest of about sixty-five with a big belly, short legs, a pink, jowly, clean-shaven face, puffy sleepy eyes, bushy white eyebrows and a fringe of white curls poking out under a long red-and-white striped nightcap with a tassel. He wears only his long, crumpled white nightshirt reaching his ankles and a pair of fluffy blue felt slippers.

places.name: the Turnip Field
places.look: A small turnip field on a gentle slope, with rows of big purple-and-white turnips under bushy green leaves and a grey wooden rail fence along its upper edge. Below the field lies a soft, brown bog dotted with round grassy tussocks and tufts of white cotton grass, and a clear little stream with flat stones winds along the edge of the bog under a few birches. A small red farmhouse stands far off.
